title: feat(objectql, cli)!: run the record-currency code backfill one organization at a time

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D5TuSiSXrriwnF8WM65LyQr)_

domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyT9hHRjH6qFYychv1

Fixes #30674

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `backfillRecordCurrencyCodes` and `os migrate record-currency-codes`, given no organization over the rows of more than one organization, are refused with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (`field: 'organizationId'`) before any write, where they wrote the one code into every organization's codeless rows; widened beside it: the optional `organizationId` / `allOrganizations` options, the `--org` / `--all-organizations` flags, and `recomputeHomeAmounts`'s optional `organizationId` with `os migrate recompute-home-amounts --org`.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md (its "Backfill: `os migrate record-currency-codes`" hint names neither `--org` nor `--all-organizations`, so on a multi-organization database it leads to the refusal; `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` is updated here)

Claim: 6671428099 (amended 6671472723, 6671734394) · Branch: `claude/project-thread-erl0zi` · Ruling-ref: 6670707546 (letter C, items A and 3)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：币种码回填按组织走。`os migrate record-currency-codes --org ID` 只写这个组织的无码行；库里这个对象的行属于多个组织、又没给 `--org` 时，命令在任何写入前拒跑（退出 1），并列出每个组织的无码行数；`--all-organizations` 是显式「一码写全部组织」；两个一起给是用法错误。重算命令 `recompute-home-amounts` 加了同样的 `--org`，不给照旧跑全部组织、不拒跑。
- 为什么改：每个组织有自己的本位币，一个 `--code` 写进所有组织的无码行，对其他组织是静默写错（ADR-0144 Open item 13，裁决 6670707546 C 的 A 项和第 3 项）。
- 风险与回滚：小。多组织库上不带范围的跑法从「写」变「拒」，这是本单的目的（BREAKING，changeset 已写迁移说明）；单组织库行为和报告文字不变，已钉。回滚即撤 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/record-currency-backfill.ts`（`resolveScope`、`backfillRecordCurrencyCodes` 的先数后写、`walkCodelessRows` 的组织过滤），`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/record-currency-codes.ts` 的拒跑输出，`packages/objectql/src/home-amount-recompute.ts` 的 `organizationId`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/record-currency-backfill.test.ts -t "one organization at a time"`，预期 8 条全绿，其中「two organizations and no scope」断言零写入。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/objectql` — `backfillRecordCurrencyCodes`** (`record-currency-backfill.ts`)

- New options `organizationId` and `allOrganizations`. The report gains `organizationId`, `allOrganizations` and `organizations` (the same counts per organization, ordered by id, null last).
- `organizationId`: the walk and every `engine.update` run under `{ isSystem: true, tenantId: organizationId }` (ruling item A.1), and the keyset walk also carries `where: { organization_id: organizationId }`. See the first acceptance note for why both.
- Neither option: the rows are walked once read-only and counted per organization. More than one named organization ⇒ `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400, `field: 'organizationId'`, with `organizations` on the error, before any write, on a dry run as on an apply run. Otherwise the run proceeds exactly as before (an apply run walks a second time to write).
- `allOrganizations`: the one code into every organization's codeless rows, under the unscoped system context (today's behaviour, now explicit).
- Refused before any row is read: both options together, a blank `organizationId` (`VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400), and `organizationId` on an object that stores no `organization_id` (`INVALID_FIELD` / 400, `field: 'organization_id'`).
- The report text gains a scope phrase and per-organization lines only for a scoped or all-organizations run; an unscoped single-organization run prints exactly what it printed before.
- ⛔ No organization's `localization.currency` is read (ADR-0144 D8 rule 4). The card allowed showing it as a reference in the refusal; this PR does not, so the backfill keeps reading nothing about currencies but the operator's `--code`.

**`@objectstack/objectql` — `recomputeHomeAmounts`** (`home-amount-recompute.ts`, ruling item 3)

- New option `organizationId`: walk, the write's reads (`homeAmountReadsFor`) and every update run under `tenantId`, the walk filters on `organization_id`, and the report and the run's audit entry carry `organizationId`. Without it, every organization, as before, never refused.
- Refused before any row is read: a blank organization (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, the run's existing code for a bad option) and an organization on an object that stores no `organization_id` (`INVALID_FIELD`).
- The `code_blank` remedy line and the header now name `--org` instead of warning that the backfill writes every organization.

**`@objectstack/cli`**

- `os migrate record-currency-codes`: `--org ID`, `--all-organizations` (oclif `exclusive` pair, so both together is a usage error, exit 2, before the probe and the boot). The multi-organization refusal prints each organization's codeless count and names both flags; under `--json` the envelope carries `code`, `httpStatus` and `organizations`. The `--apply` prompt names the scope.
- `os migrate recompute-home-amounts`: `--org ID`, handed to `recomputeHomeAmounts` as `organizationId`.
- The command only parses and prints; scope, refusal and counts are the engine function's, so the REST door (the B card) reuses them unchanged.

**Docs.** `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: a "One organization at a time" paragraph and an example for `record-currency-codes`, the `--org` sentence and example for `recompute-home-amounts`, and the `code_blank` row of its skip table.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/record-currency-backfill.test.ts`, new describe "one organization at a time" (memory driver): two organizations and no scope ⇒ refused on dry and apply, both counts, `driver.update` never called; `organizationId` writes only A and every walk page carries the filter; under `isolated` the driver also receives `tenantId`; `allOrganizations` writes both, counted apart; both options / blank ⇒ refused before any read; a tenancy-disabled object ⇒ `INVALID_FIELD`; one organization plus rows naming none ⇒ today's behaviour and today's report text.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-home-amount-projection.test.ts`, new describe "recompute: an organization filter": only B's row rewritten, A's stored amount untouched, audit entry carries the organization; without it both; refusals before any read.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/record-currency-codes.test.ts`: the flags reach the engine; the pair is a usage error with nothing probed, booted or walked; the real engine's multi-organization refusal reaches the `--json` envelope with both counts and exits 1; the human face lists both and names both flags. `recompute-home-amounts.test.ts`: `--org` reaches the engine.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/record-currency-backfill-organizations.test.ts` (new) on better-sqlite3, sqlite-wasm and PostgreSQL, under the default `single` posture: the refusal with zero writes, `--org` A then B with B's own code, all organizations, one organization unchanged. `home-amount-projection.test.ts`: the recompute's organization filter on the same three cells.
- `packages/objectql/src/federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts`: the backfill's new `organization_id` read is registered as a `skips` site (its guard reds on an unregistered reader).

## Acceptance notes

- **The system context alone does not scope a read under `single`.** `engine-driver-read-scope.test.ts` pins that `{ isSystem: true, tenantId }` reaches the driver as an organization predicate only under a walled posture (`isolated` / `group`); under `single` the verdict is `none`. A CLI boot resolves the posture from its own shell (`OS_TENANCY_POSTURE`, else `single`), which need not be the server's. So both runs also filter on the row's own `organization_id`. Measured by ablation below: without the filter the dogfood scoped pin goes red on all three drivers.
- **"More than one organization" is read from the object's own rows**, the distinct non-null `organization_id` values the walk meets, not from `sys_organization`. An organization with no row of the object has nothing the code could be wrong for, and rows that name no organization never make a run multi-organization (they ride along with an unscoped run as before).
- The organization's `localization.currency` is not shown beside the refusal's counts (the card made it optional); a door that wants it can add it from `homeAmountReadsFor` without touching this function.
- **Commit trailers.** The four commits on this branch are WIP commits without the `Claude-Session:` / `Co-authored-by:` trailer pair. The branch is already pushed and is not force-pushed, so the pair belongs in the squash message at landing.
- **Not re-exported.** The new types `RecordCurrencyBackfillOrganization` and `RecordCurrencyBackfillOrganizationsRefusal` are exported from the module but not from the `@objectstack/objectql` barrel, which names its exports one by one and lies outside this card's file surface. The CLI recognises the refusal by its `organizations` array. The B card (the REST door) can add both to the barrel when it needs them.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local tests (head f7b7814e)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run` (whole package): 556 files, 11079 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/record-currency-backfill.test.ts src/engine-home-amount-projection.test.ts src/federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts`: green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/record-currency-codes.test.ts src/commands/migrate/recompute-home-amounts.test.ts`: 2 files, 26 tests passed (the migrate command tests live in the `integration` project; `--project unit` selects nothing).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/record-currency-backfill-organizations.test.ts test/home-amount-projection.test.ts` with `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` set (local PostgreSQL 16): 2 files, 57 tests passed, the PostgreSQL cells included.
- Type-check of `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/dogfood`: exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations</summary>

Each mutation was made on disk, measured red, restored, and measured green again.

1. The refusal (`named.length > 1` changed to `> 999` in `backfillRecordCurrencyCodes`): the objectql pin "two organizations and no scope" goes red; restored green.
2. The organization filter (the `where` on the scoped walk removed): two objectql pins go red. Then, because dogfood resolves `@objectstack/objectql` through its `dist`, the same mutation was rebuilt into `dist`, `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` confirmed the mutation was present in the built output, and the scoped dogfood pin went red on all three cells (better-sqlite3, sqlite-wasm, PostgreSQL). After the restore and rebuild, the preflight reported the marker absent, the tree was clean, and all cells were green.

A first attempt at ablation 2 mutated only `src` and the dogfood leg stayed green. That was a false green: the dogfood leg never read the mutated source. It is not counted above. The rebuild and preflight above replace it.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, reconciled with --ran)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 94 families on this tree. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe (`gates-final.txt`).


On the first pass, three families exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), which are not findings:
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed a deeper clone.
- `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed built `dist/` for client-react, studio, embedder-openai, knowledge-memory, knowledge-ragflow, service-cluster-redis and service-knowledge.

After `git fetch --unshallow origin main` and a build of those packages, all three were rerun and exited 0. The CI families outside the derivation are read from the PR's check-runs, not rerun here.

</details>
